Mixed acquisitions: acoustic 1998–2012 and lidar 2009–2010; publication/merge processing 2016 is not the acquisition year. This published nearshore grid was resampled by its producer from the 2013 NOAA TopoBathy Merge to 2 m; the separate MBARI 5 m product was not merged into it. 2 m is delivered grid spacing, not a per-cell sounding precision or proof of native fine detail. Source metadata reports accuracy no better than 2 m horizontal / 0.20 m vertical; NAVD88 depths remain nominal. Actual input interpolation/lineage masks unavailable.
